bounds.quote: Rest the top of the rear foot on the bench and settle the hips square over the stance.
bounds.bound: farAnkle = [-18.5, 13.0] with farFoot = 180 rests the top of the rear foot on chainFlatBench(-34, -16, 12.0), while the front foot stays planted at ankle = [13.5, 2.16] with foot = 0 and standing front knee 174.1 deg.

bounds.quote: Drop the rear knee straight down.
bounds.bound: Rear knee drops from y = 22.32 at ph = 0 to y = 3.29 at ph = 2 (vertical drop 19.03 units) with horizontal drift 0.16 units (< 0.5), and front foot sole contact stays on the floor across every tick.

bounds.quote: Set the bar as for a squat and stand close to a box that puts your thigh near parallel when your foot is up.
bounds.bound: At ph = 0 on box y = 20.0, the lead thigh is at -10.0 deg from horizontal (<= 12 deg), with a rigid barbell across the upper back (3D wrist span 33.12 constant across every tick).

bounds.quote: Put the whole foot on the box and stand up through it — the floor leg hangs, it does not jump.
bounds.bound: Lead foot stays planted flat on the box at y = 22.16 across every tick, top standing knee reaches 175.0 deg (>= 172 deg), trailing foot hangs behind the box at y = 21.63, and 3D CoM with the 0.40 bodyweight bar stays over [0, 5.4] ([1.88, 3.69]).

bounds.quote: Lower on a controlled count until the floor toe touches, and go again without rocking.
bounds.bound: Lowering segment duration is 1500 ms vs 1100 ms drive up, and at ph = 0 the trailing toe touches the floor at y = 2.16 while the trailing ankle stays elevated at y = 4.83.

bounds.quote: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand close to a box that puts your thigh near parallel when your foot is up.
bounds.bound: At ph = 0 on box y = 20.0, the lead thigh is at -10.0 deg from horizontal (<= 12 deg) while dumbbells hang quiet at the sides (upperArm = [-90, 8], forearm = [-90, 6]).

bounds.quote: Dumbbells hang quiet at your sides.
bounds.bound: World-space upperArm[0] = -90 deg and forearm[0] = -90 deg on every tick while 3D CoM with 0.25 bodyweight dumbbells stays over the standing foot [0, 5.4] ([1.10, 3.31]).

bounds.quote: Step forward with one leg and lower the hips straight down under control, keeping the torso upright.
bounds.bound: Lead ankle steps forward 22.50 units from x = -6.0 (ph = 0, both knees 174.1 deg) to x = 16.5 (ph = 1), then hips drop straight down from [0.0, 41.20] to [0.0, 24.80] (dx = 0.00, dy = 16.40) with trunk = 89 deg across every tick.

bounds.quote: Complete the repetitions on one leg, then change legs.
bounds.bound: The post-set instruction to change legs appears only in the final frame caption (p7) and in none of p1..p6.

bounds.quote: Step back off the platform with one leg and lower until the back knee reaches the floor.
bounds.bound: From standing on the y = 6.0 platform (both ankles at y = 8.16, both knees 174.1 deg), the rear ankle steps back to x = -18.5 and lowers until the rear knee reaches y = 2.841 (painted bottom 96.891 at FLOOR = 96.9).

bounds.quote: Drive through the front leg to return to the platform, then repeat with the other leg.
bounds.bound: After driving back to standing on the platform at ph = 1, the movement alternates legs to ph = 2 where the far leg steps back to x = -18.5 and its knee reaches y = 2.841 (painted bottom 96.891 at FLOOR = 96.9).

bounds.quote: Step forward with the opposite foot and lower the back knee toward the floor with the torso upright, passing the kettlebell under the front leg to the other hand.
bounds.bound: From standing with the kettlebell in the near hand (bellSide = +1, knees 174.1 deg), the opposite (far) foot steps forward to x = 11.5 and the kettlebell passes under the front thigh (bell y = 10.61 < thigh midpoint y = 16.72 - 3.0) from bellSide = +0.45 to -0.85.

bounds.bound: Returns to standing at ph = 3 with the bell in the far hand (bellSide = -1, knees 174.1 deg), then steps the near foot forward to x = 11.5 (ph = 4 -> 5) and passes the bell under the front thigh back to the near hand (bellSide = -0.45 -> +0.85).

bounds.quote: Hold a light kettlebell at the chest and stand on one leg with the other leg reaching forward.
bounds.bound: Standing leg is rooted at [0, 2.16] with top knee 175.0 deg (>= 172 deg), free leg reaches forward straight at 176.0 deg across every tick with painted sole <= 91.8 < FLOOR - 5.0, and the kettlebell is held at the chest.

bounds.bound: Rooted at toe = [5.4, 7.968] on the y = 6.0 block with a rigid barbell across the upper back (3D wrist span 33.12) and straight knees (179.0 deg >= 172 deg) across every tick.

bounds.bound: At ph = 2 (foot = -42 deg), the ankle rises to y = 11.77 (+5.77 units above the block top) and holds a 450 ms top pause (p4 -> p5) with 3D CoM + bar over the forefoot.
